plan.title: feat(scope,authz): bind scope:decompose apply to human-origin draft digest grant

narratives.Description: scope:decompose apply can accept a structurally valid draft without durable proof a human approved those exact bytes. Epic #3237 locked structural apply to .deft/authz human-origin grants bound to draft digest. Without that gate, agent-origin apply remains fail-open.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator, I want decompose apply to require a human-origin grant bound to the exact draft digest, so that agents cannot apply unapproved draft bytes.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Extend packages/core/src/authz grant mint/verify for operation scope.decompose.apply.structural. In packages/core/src/scope/decompose.ts apply path, require a human-origin grant binding project root identity, parent artifact path, target path, and SHA-256 draft content digest; reject missing, expired, mismatched, and agent-origin grants. Leave --check ungated. Add tests under packages/core/src/scope and packages/core/src/authz. Run vitest on those packages and task check. Cite #3239 in CHANGELOG.md.
narratives.Overview: feat(scope,authz): bind scope:decompose apply to human-origin draft digest grant
narratives.NonGoals: Out of issue scope; see epic #3237 current-shape.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Acceptance items from locked epic contracts.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a valid draft JSON and no grant under .deft/authz/grants, when scope:decompose apply runs, it exits non-zero without writing child stories.
Given a human-origin grant bound to digest X, when the draft bytes change to digest Y, apply exits non-zero.

evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/scope/decompose.test.ts:grant for digest X cannot apply changed draft Y

narrative.Acceptance: Given a matching human-origin structural grant, when apply runs on that draft, apply succeeds.
Given --check only, when no grant exists, check still runs without requiring a grant.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/scope packages/core/src/authz
